title: Cops Have No Idea He’s About to Murder Someone
description:
Bodycam footage caught the moment a murder suspect in Longview, Washington, was stopped by police over a license plate issue just hours before allegedly carrying out a deadly attack. A week after Alexander Lee Rogers, 51, was stopped over a mismatched registration, he was caught nearly 1,000 miles away in Los Angeles, California, after he was connected to a stabbing attack that left one woman dead and a man seriously injured. Watch the incident unfold on this episode of Law&Crime BodyCam.

Watch More Police Bodycam Videos: https://bit.ly/WatchBodycamVideos
Subscribe to Law&Crime BodyCam: https://bit.ly/LawAndCrimeBodyCam  

#Washington #Bodycam #LawAndCrime

Law&Crime is the leading multi-platform network that covers live court video, high-profile criminal trials, crazy crime, and smart legal analysis. Law&Crime BodyCam takes you on patrol and in the line of duty with raw footage of police encounters. Grounded in expert narration and insightful commentary from a trusted journalist and attorney, each episode of BodyCam features high-stakes situations with expert analysis.
